newsitem.title: USA: US W.Coast gasolines flat on mixed supply signals.
newsitem.headline: US W.Coast gasolines flat on mixed supply signals.

text.p: U.S. West Coast wholesale unleaded gasoline remained steady Tuesday, with traders sidestepping the market as new inventory data showed a mixed supply picture.

West Coast (PADD V) gasoline fell 596,000 barrels last week, in sharp contrast to a nationwide build of 3.6 million. Most of the build came in the the East Coast, which gained 3.4 million, according to the American Petroleum Institute (API).
"West Coast fundamentals were bullish, but nationwide they're not," said one trader. "That's brought things to a standstill this afternoon."
